title: Glowing pancakes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- plate -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="80" rx="38" ry="9" fill="#c9d8ff"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="78" rx="34" ry="7" fill="#eaf0ff"/>
  <!-- shadow under pancakes -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="75" rx="26" ry="5" fill="#b98a4a" opacity="0.5"/>
  <!-- bottom pancake -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="72" rx="27" ry="8" fill="#e8a94e"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="69" rx="27" ry="8" fill="#f7c26b"/>
  <!-- middle pancake -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="25" ry="8" fill="#e8a94e"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="59" rx="25" ry="8" fill="#ffd080"/>
  <!-- top pancake -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="52" rx="23" ry="8" fill="#e8a94e"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="49" rx="23" ry="8" fill="#ffe09a"/>
  <!-- syrup drips on top -->
  <path d="M30 50 Q32 44 38 47 Q36 52 30 50 Z" fill="#b5651d"/>
  <path d="M62 48 Q66 42 72 46 Q68 51 62 48 Z" fill="#b5651d"/>
  <!-- syrup pool -->
  <path d="M36 47 Q50 42 64 47 Q58 52 50 51 Q42 52 36 47 Z" fill="#c4731f"/>
  <path d="M40 46 Q50 43 60 46 Q54 49 50 49 Q46 49 40 46 Z" fill="#e08a2e"/>
  <!-- butter pat -->
  <rect x="43" y="38" width="14" height="8" rx="2" fill="#fff4b0"/>
  <rect x="43" y="38" width="14" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#fffce8"/>
  <rect x="43" y="43" width="14" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#ffe680"/>
  <!-- butter shine -->
  <rect x="45" y="39" width="3" height="1.5" rx="0.7" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- glow lines around pancakes -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="55" rx="32" ry="30" fill="none" stroke="#ffdb7a" stroke-width="1.2" opacity="0.35"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="55" rx="36" ry="34" fill="none" stroke="#ffdb7a" stroke-width="0.8" opacity="0.2"/>
  <!-- little sparkles -->
  <path d="M18 40 l2 4 l-4 0 l2-4 Z" fill="#fff4b0" opacity="0.9"/>
  <path d="M80 34 l2 4 l-4 0 l2-4 Z" fill="#fff4b0" opacity="0.8"/>
  <path d="M74 68 l2.5 4 l-5 0 l2.5-4 Z" fill="#fff4b0" opacity="0.7"/>
  <path d="M24 66 l2 3 l-4 0 l2-3 Z" fill="#fff4b0" opacity="0.7"/>
</svg>
